Subject: MedForge trial — environment options & success criteria (recap)

Hi Liam — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have a single source of truth. Please confirm or correct anything below.

Summary of objectives (what success looks like)
- Latency: 95th pctile under 350ms for 256-token responses across your nightly batch of 10k concurrent session tests.
- Accuracy: Reranking/QA F1 target > 0.82 on the provided benchmark prompts.
- Cost: Target per-1000-token unit cost below your current vendor baseline by at least 15%.
- Security: SOC2 + auditable access logs; VPC option if PHI / customer PII is required to remain in your network.

Evaluation plan & tests we proposed
1) Integration smoke (1 week): SDK + API integration, basic generation tests, auth flow.
2) Functional QA (1 week): run your benchmark prompts, check metrics and examples.
3) Load & stability (2 weeks): simulated concurrency & streaming verification.
4) Regression & quality verification (ongoing): reranker/QA batches and manual spot checks.

Environment options (high-level)
- Hosted (fastest onboarding): Redwood-managed, immediate credentials, no infra for your team. Good for initial functional QA and early demos.
- Dedicated sandbox (reserved GPUs): Isolated capacity, better for consistent latency & stress testing. Configurable autoscale for load tests.
- VPC / Private deployment: Customer-managed network and KMS for regulated PHI — required if MedForge needs data to remain on-prem/VPC.

Preliminary recommendation based on today's discussion:
- Start with Hosted for integration and functional QA (1 week).
- Move to Dedicated sandbox for load/stability tests and tuning (weeks 2–3).
- Evaluate VPC only if your legal/compliance team flags PHI residency concerns — we can scope that in parallel.

Owners & timeline
- Karthik Iyer (sales/PM): schedule kickoff and commercial items (me).
- Monica Patel (solutions onboarding): onboarding tasks, API keys, test harness integration.
- Marissa Cole (SE): performance profiling and quantization recommendations.

Immediate asks for MedForge
- Confirm success criteria above or send edits (esp. latency and security needs).
- Provide a sample of benchmark prompts and a small test dataset (anonymized) we can use for the functional QA.
- Confirm preferred start date for the trial (we suggested Mon Nov 20).

Attachments: medforge_success_criteria.xlsx (blank template) and runbook link will be shared in next email.

Thanks — I can schedule a 30-minute kickoff as early as Monday if that works.

Best,

- Timeline: Nov 20 start is acceptable for the hosted integration work. We want the dedicated sandbox by Nov 27 to run the load tests.

Quick question: for the dedicated sandbox — can we reserve a predictable GPU profile (e.g., 8x A100-equivalent) for the two-week stress window? We need consistent perf for regression comparisons.

Liam — great to meet you on the call. Quick operational notes and a draft on how we run the two-phase trial to match your requirements. See inline and action items below.

1) Dedicated sandbox GPU reservation
- Yes — we can reserve an 8x A100-class pool for your stress window. That will be booked as "dedicated-sandbox-MedForge" for the 1-week reserved period (Nov 27–Dec 3). If you need a longer commit we can extend under a short-term reserved rate.

2) Hosted -> Dedicated staging flow (detailed runbook)
- Day 0 (Nov 20): Hosted integration kickoff — we provide API keys, a small sample dataset, and Postman snippets.
- Days 1–7: Functional QA on Hosted. Marissa runs initial profiling and shares perf baselines and tuning recommendations.
- Day 8 (Nov 27): Switch traffic to Dedicated sandbox for load tests (Monitored by Monica & Marissa).
- Days 8–14: Load & stability tests; we run concurrent session profiles and streaming checks.
- Day 15: Final pass and delivery of perf report + recommendations.

3) Compliance & VPC notes
- If any patient data cannot leave your VPC, we will not ingest those datasets into Hosted/Dedicated. Instead, we will provide a VPC deployment estimate and an onboarding checklist (KMS integration, firewall rules, IP allowlist).
- We will send a sample access log format and audit checklist ahead of the SOW.

4) Owners & action items
- Monica Patel (onboarding lead): create test credentials, open tickets for reserved GPU, coordinate test harness.
- Marissa Cole (SE): perf profiling, quantization suggestions, tuning guide.
- Karthik Iyer: commercial/contract touchpoints, milestone signoff.
- Liam / MedForge: deliver masked benchmark prompts + dataset; confirm legal/compliance constraints.

5) Next steps and meetings
- Proposed kickoff: Nov 20, 10:00–10:30 PT — 30m technical integration call (Monica + Marissa + MedForge engs).
- Reserve dedicated pool: will submit internal reservation request today and share confirmation by EOD Nov 21.

Attachments: I've attached a draft runbook (redwood-poc-runbook.pdf) and the success criteria template. Also linking the drive folder with test-harness scripts.

If that all looks good I will create the HubSpot milestone and an internal task list so we can track owner handoffs.
